caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an ornate design, shown in three-quarter view. The chair has a reddish-brown color on the wooden frame, with intricate carvings on the backrest and legs. The backrest has three vertical splats with elaborate scrollwork and a central carved medallion at the top. The seat is rectangular and upholstered in a green fabric with a gold or yellow geometric pattern. The front legs are cabriole style with decorative carvings at the knees and end in claw-and-ball feet, while the back legs are straighter and less decorated. The drawing is presented within a rectangular frame with thin red lines, and in the upper left corner, a small inset sketch outlines the chair's profile and provides simple red-brown dimension lines with numerical annotations. The background is a plain off-white or cream color.
title: Mahogany Chair
